chart.title: Status of net-zero carbon emissions targets
chart.subtitle: The inclusion criteria for net-zero commitments may vary from country to country. For example, the inclusion of international aviation emissions; or the acceptance of carbon offsets. To see the year for which countries have pledged to achieve net-zero, hover over the country in the interactive version of this chart.
chart.note: Includes net-zero targets and other emissions-reduction targets, not strictly net-zero.

Status of net-zero carbon emissions targ.descriptionShort: Status of each country's commitment to 'net-zero' emissions. The specifics of this commitment can vary, with some countries pledging to reach net-zero greenhouse gas emissions, while others define this as carbon emissions only. Countries assessed as having no net-zero target are shown as "No target".
Status of net-zero carbon emissions targ.descriptionKey:
- A country's net-zero status reflects the most firmly established form its commitment has taken. From strongest to weakest, the possible statuses are: achieved (externally validated), achieved (self-declared), in law, in policy document, declaration or pledge, and proposed or in discussion. Countries assessed as having no net-zero target are shown as "No target".
- The inclusion criteria for net-zero commitments may vary from country to country. For example, the inclusion of international aviation emissions, or the acceptance of carbon offsets.
